title: Serum Concentrations, Physical and Psychological Well-being in Metabolic Syndrome
brief_summary: The purpose of this study was to investigate the serum concentrations, physical and psychological well-being characteristics in patients having chronic musculoskeletal pain with metabolic syndrome, and to compare patients without metabolic syndrome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

To be a volunteer patient with a chronic non-specific musculoskeletal pain disorder, including knee osteoarthritis, rotator cuff tear, adhesive capsulitis, and non-specific low back, back or neck pain for more than 6 months.

Exclusion Criteria:

the presence of severe physical disability, psychiatric disorder, malignant tumors, pregnancy, chronic alcohol consumption, gout, heart failure, liver and renal dysfunction.
study_population: patients having chronic musculoskeletal pain with and without metabolic syndrome
